title: Simulation & Volumetric Verification
brief: Integrate novel toolpath algorithms with volumetric simulation, force/temperature prediction along the actual toolpath, and surface finish prediction.

units.title: NovelToolpathSimulator — Force/temp/deflection along path
units.description: Given novel algorithm output + material + tool: compute at each segment point: cutting force Fc (Kienzle), radial force Fr (0.3-0.5×Fc), axial force Fa (0.15-0.25×Fc), torque T = Fc×d/2, spindle power P = Fc×Vc/60000, temperature rise ΔT (Jaeger), tool deflection δ (cantilever), surface roughness Ra (Brammertz). Produces force/temp/deflection profiles. Validates PTDC predictions, TGAR thermal zones, CFSF force constancy.

units.title: VoxelStockIntegration — Material removal tracking
units.description: Connect novel algorithm segments to VoxelStockEngine for volumetric material removal simulation. Track: remaining stock volume, engagement angle at each point (actual vs predicted), air cutting detection, residual stock identification. Uses swept volume of cutter along segment path. Outputs: stock-at-each-step for IPW (in-process workpiece) roughing, engagement corrections for VCMR/TGAR.
exit_conditions: Voxel stock removal from novel segments

units.title: CollisionIntegrationEngine — Tool assembly collision with novel paths
units.description: Run full collision detection on novel algorithm output: tool body + holder + spindle vs stock + fixtures + machine structure. Use collision-avoidance-data.json (22,062 tools). For 5-axis: check at each segment with (x,y,z,i,j,k) orientation. Integrates with MACS (swarf cutting — high collision risk), HBCF (barrel cutter — large swept volume), and PTDC (compensated coordinates may approach stock).

units.title: SurfaceFinishPredictorEngine — Scallop + roughness from novel paths
units.description: Predict final surface finish from novel algorithm output: (1) kinematic roughness Rk = f²/(32×R) for ball endmill, (2) scallop height h = R - sqrt(R² - (ae/2)²), (3) feed mark spacing, (4) vibration contribution from HRAF resonance avoidance, (5) deflection contribution from PTDC compensation. Combines: Rk + Ra_vibration + Ra_deflection. For CFSF: verify constant-force → uniform finish. For AMEF: verify morphed engagement → uniform scallop.

units.title: CycleTimeAccuracyEngine — Precise time from novel G-code
units.description: Compute precise cycle time from generated G-code: (1) rapid traverse time with acceleration/deceleration profiles (trapezoidal velocity), (2) cutting time from actual feed rates (not programmed — includes look-ahead, corner deceleration), (3) tool change time (ATC time per machine profile), (4) dwell time, (5) spindle accel/decel time for RPM changes (HRAF varies RPM). Uses machine-kinematics-catalog.ts for axis max velocities and accelerations. Compare novel vs conventional time.
